Six (6) months experience in processing and assembly of surgical instruments. and
Experience requirement may be waived for individuals who have successfully completed a Central Services Technician (CST) externship at Sequoia Hospital.
One year experience in general transcription required. Two years general secretary experience and
Minimum of three (3) to five (5) years combined experience in healthcare industry and
Experience/training in EKG interpretation preferred. Experience in billing systems preferred. Experience in event coordination preferred.

Ensures a professional and responsive atmosphere by greeting patients, visitors, staff, and physicians promptly and courteously. Refers to each individual by name when appropriate. Screens individuals by requesting to see identification or visitor pass.
Operates, cleans and maintains equipment.
Collects, processes and sterilizes articles from all areas including Operating Room on a priority basis.

Serves as SPD liaison with physicians offices and Instrument Vendors by obtaining special requests prior to elective surgery and assuring that required instruments are prepared and available as needed.
With the aid of computer based lists, inspects, maintains, assembles, and picks Operating Room instruments and sets, coordinating activities with Operation Room Surgical Schedule and OR Staff.
Runs and monitors the biological test for the stream and Sterrad (low temperature) sterilizers.
Cert Sterile Processing Dist Tech (CSPDT-CBSPD), upon hire
